original_text:
Rule 1: The agent may not write a final deliverable memorandum when the
number of cleared-items sections the memorandum contains is zero. A
cleared-items section is a section documenting the matters that were
reviewed and found not to constitute red flags. Writing a final
deliverable memorandum while the number of cleared-items sections it
contains is zero is forbidden.
Rule 2: The agent may not write a final deliverable memorandum when the
number of engagement clients named in the memorandum's address block is
zero. Writing a final deliverable memorandum while the number of
engagement clients named in its address block is zero is forbidden.
Rule 3: The agent may not write a final deliverable memorandum when the
number of issuing firms named in the memorandum's address block is zero.
Writing a final deliverable memorandum while the number of issuing firms
named in its address block is zero is forbidden.
Rule 4: The agent may not write a final deliverable memorandum when the
number of references to the engagement matter in the memorandum is zero.
Writing a final deliverable memorandum while the number of references to
the engagement matter it contains is zero is forbidden.
smt:
(set-logic QF_LIRA)
; var numClearedItemsSections (Int): The number of cleared-items sections contained in the final deliverable memorandum. A cleared-items section is a section documenting the matters that were reviewed and found not to constitute red flags. Must be zero or greater.
(declare-const numClearedItemsSections Int)
; var numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock (Int): The number of engagement clients named in the final deliverable memorandum's address block. Must be zero or greater.
(declare-const numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock Int)
; var numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock (Int): The number of issuing firms named in the final deliverable memorandum's address block. Must be zero or greater.
(declare-const numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock Int)
; var numReferencesToEngagementMatter (Int): The number of references to the engagement matter contained in the final deliverable memorandum. Must be zero or greater.
(declare-const numReferencesToEngagementMatter Int)
; var isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed (Bool): Whether the agent is permitted to write a final deliverable memorandum given the conditions of the memorandum's contents and address block.
(declare-const isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed Bool)
; Rule DR1ZLXQQ6475 (numClearedItemsSections is at least 0)
(assert (>= numClearedItemsSections
    0))
; Rule SM1GKTF9WLWF (numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock is at least 0)
(assert (>= numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock
    0))
; Rule A2SY2FIN9BB0 (numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock is at least 0)
(assert (>= numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock
    0))
; Rule FKL4BYQUJDJK (numReferencesToEngagementMatter is at least 0)
(assert (>= numReferencesToEngagementMatter
    0))
; Rule SF3JCXM5DFFT (if numClearedItemsSections is equal to 0, then isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is false)
(assert (=> (= numClearedItemsSections
       0)
    (not isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed)))
; Rule MDDP8US29YI3 (if numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock is equal to 0, then isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is false)
(assert (=> (= numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock
       0)
    (not isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed)))
; Rule CVJXR2ZEPSL3 (if numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock is equal to 0, then isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is false)
(assert (=> (= numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock
       0)
    (not isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed)))
; Rule KTBQJFBT8PDR (if numReferencesToEngagementMatter is equal to 0, then isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is false)
(assert (=> (= numReferencesToEngagementMatter
       0)
    (not isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed)))
; Rule H0JNISZUP1G9 (if isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is true, then numClearedItemsSections is greater than 0)
(assert (=> isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed
    (> numClearedItemsSections
       0)))
; Rule WZDA0X0R9I5H (if isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is true, then numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock is greater than 0)
(assert (=> isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed
    (> numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock
       0)))
; Rule X2ZVED35J0O4 (if isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is true, then numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock is greater than 0)
(assert (=> isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed
    (> numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock
       0)))
; Rule LQE1ZB7FGCMS (if isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is true, then numReferencesToEngagementMatter is greater than 0)
(assert (=> isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed
    (> numReferencesToEngagementMatter
       0)))
; Rule VIHGFHP73ZN4 (if isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed is false, then at least one of the following 4 statements is true: 1) numClearedItemsSections is no more than 0; 2) numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock is no more than 0; 3) numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock is no more than 0; 4) numReferencesToEngagementMatter is no more than 0)
(assert (=> (not isWriteFinalDeliverableMemorandumAllowed)
    (or (not (> numClearedItemsSections
                0))
        (not (> numEngagementClientsInAddressBlock
                0))
        (not (> numIssuingFirmsInAddressBlock
                0))
        (not (> numReferencesToEngagementMatter
                0)))))
(check-sat)
(get-model)
